Title: Toxicity at clinical trial stage
Description: Separates drugs that reached FDA approval from those that failed in advanced clinical trials for toxicity reasons, using the ClinTox collection from MoleculeNet. The two outcomes are predicted as independent probabilities rather than as a single verdict. A graph transformer pretrained on 10 million unlabelled molecules was fine-tuned on the pairing. The set of clinically failed drugs is small and its failures span many mechanisms, so a high toxicity score signals resemblance to known failures rather than a specific liability.
Interpretation: Probability of FDA approval and probability of clinical trial failure through toxicity.
